fullPassage: Dear Ms. MacAlpine, I was so excited to hear that your brand is opening a new shop on Bruns Street next month. I have always appreciated the way your brand helps women to feel more stylish and confident. I am writing in response to your ad in the Bruns Journal. I graduated from the Meline School of Fashion and have worked as a sales assistant at LoganMart for the last five years. During that time, I've developed strong customer service and sales skills, and now I would like to apply for the sales position in your clothing store. I am available for an interview at your earliest convenience. I look forward to hearing from you. Thank you for reading my letter. Yours sincerely, Grace Braddock

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① excited — appreciated — confident: 원문 일치. 새 매장 소식에 신이 났고(excited), 브랜드를 감사히 여겨왔으며(appreciated), 여성들이 더 자신감 있게(confident) 느끼도록 돕는다 ←정답

❌ ② bored(지루한): excited(신이 난)의 반의어로 부적절

❌ ③ criticized(비판했다): appreciated(감사했다)의 반의어로 부적절

❌ ④ insecure(불안한): confident(자신감 있는)의 반의어로 부적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② opening — helps — response: 원문 일치. 새 매장을 여는(opening) 것, 브랜드가 여성을 돕는(helps) 방식, 광고에 대한 응답(response)으로 편지를 쓴다 ←정답

❌ ① closing(닫는): opening(여는)의 반의어로 부적절

❌ ③ prevents(막다): helps(돕다)의 반의어로 부적절

❌ ④ request(요청): 'in response to your ad'에서 response(응답)가 적절

det.korean: ①신이 난 ②감사했다 ③멋진 ④자신감 있는→불안한
det.analysis:
① excited(신이 난): 새 매장 소식에 신이 났다는 맥락에 적절 ✅

③ stylish(멋진): 여성들이 더 멋지게 느끼도록 돕는다는 맥락에 적절 ✅

④ insecure(불안한): 브랜드가 여성을 '자신감 있게' 느끼도록 돕는다는 맥락이므로 confident(자신감 있는)가 적절. insecure는 반의어로 부적절 ←정답

det.tip: respond(동사) → response(명사), in response to ~: ~에 응답하여

❌ ③ read the Bruns Journal(신문을 읽다): 이미 광고를 본 상태로 목적이 아님

❌ ④ graduate from fashion school(패션 학교를 졸업하다): 이미 졸업한 과거 사실

questions.passage: Dear Ms. MacAlpine, I was so excited to hear that your brand is opening a new shop on Bruns Street next month. I have always appreciated the way your brand helps women to feel more stylish and confident. I am writing in response to your ad in the Bruns Journal. I graduated from the Meline School of Fashion and have worked as a sales assistant at LoganMart for the last five years. During that time, I've developed strong customer service and sales skills, and now I would like to apply for the sales position in your clothing store. I am __________ at your earliest convenience. I look forward to hearing from you. Thank you for reading my letter. Yours sincerely, Grace Braddock
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 새 매장을 여는/곧 나라를 떠나는/오래된 사업을 닫는/면접에 응할 수 있는

❌ ② leaving the country soon(곧 나라를 떠나는): 면접과 반대되는 상황
